notes.title: We're in Turn-Based RPG Fest 2024
notes.content:
Patrons of the Great Library,

We're happy to announce a new demo build for Scarlet Record! 

What's new:
[list]
[*]New and improved node exploration system--now it comes with narrative that grants boons or curses to your party.
[*]New enemies that can be found in certain area
[*]Added two additional difficulty setting: Story for those who wants to follow the story while having a bit of kick in combat; and Challenging for those seeking for challenges against various enemies throughout Ruby's journey
[*]Several visual updates as well as QoL features
[*]A few housekeepings
[/list]

As always, if you're interested in following Scarlet Record's development, feel free to follow [url=https://twitter.com/_CrescentSun]our X (FKA Twitter) account[/url]--we usually post our progress weekly. Or join our Discord server.


That's all from us for now.
Cheers!

notes.title: 0.5.2.4 Demo Update
notes.content:
Patrons of the Great Library,

Thank you for playing Scarlet Record!
An update for Scarlet Record demo has been implemented. The update covers:
[list]
[*]Fixes for several minor glitches including scanline functionality, status buildup and Cure Pill doesn't clear ailments in combat;
[*]Minor tweaks on current node maps--now boss encounter nodes will show a proper icon
[*]Minor tweaks on several characters, including Hazel's visual animation fix and a crash involving one of Verde's perks; and 
[*]A small revamp on several dialogue lines
[/list]

As always, if you're interested in following Scarlet Record's development, feel free to follow [url=https://twitter.com/_CrescentSun]our X (FKA Twitter) account[/url]--we usually post our progress weekly. Or join our Discord server.


That's all from us for now.
Cheers!

notes.title: Scarlet Record's New Demo Released!
notes.content:
Yet another milestone have been reached!

As part of upcoming step up in development, we're happy to announce that a new Scarlet Record demo has been released. The demo showcases not only the overall game improvements compared to its predecessor, it also introduces several new features that laid a foundation for future contents up to its full version.

Not only that, we've done a bit of facelift on the store page. Considering this is an ongoing project, expect a few more changes as we make progress.

If you're interested in following Scarlet Record's development, feel free to follow [url=https://twitter.com/_CrescentSun]our X (FKA Twitter) account[/url]--we usually post our progress weekly. Or join our Discord server.


That's all from us for now.
Cheers!

notes.title: Scarlet Record Demo is now Available (Steam Next Fest Oct 2023)!
notes.content:
A demo version of Scarlet Record is now available on Steam! It has a much shorter content since welp, it's a demo after all, but the sauce is still there.

Bear witness to Ruby's first journey outside the Great Library in the upcoming demo which will be available on Steam Next Fest (Oct 2023)!

The demo can be downloaded here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2365920/Scarlet_Record/

Shoutouts to everyone who's involved in the development up till now. We wouldn't make it happen without you all. Y'all are truly wonderful.

Cheers, and have a good one!
